notes: Chroma Audio Suite v2.9.0 / 2026.11.10: ChromaCoreVST v2.9.0 with Osc 4 Internal Live Resampler & Time-Stretch Layer, 14-Source Right-Click Modulation Matrix, Living Organic Wavetable Interference Visualizer, Raised 3D Synth Deck & Recessed Keybed; ChromaScramble v2.9.0 Low-Color Hardware Theme, 3D Protruding Titanium Knobs & Bold Typography; and Brushed Gunmetal Patch Note Release Cards across all 14 plugins.

ChromaCore.notes: ChromaCoreVST v2.9.0: Added Osc 4 Internal Synth Resampler ([BOUNCE MIX] & [REC LIVE] with 4 playback engines: TIME STRETCH, WT RESAMPLE, GRAIN FREEZE, REV PING-PONG), Universal Right-Click Modulation Matrix across every knob (14 Serum-2 style sources: LFO 1-2, ENV 1-3, NOTE, VEL, MODW, AT, RAND, ALT, CHAOS, S&H, MACRO), fixed MOD OSC target routing to Osc 1/2/3/All, added Living Organic Wavetable Interference Visualizer, raised 3D synth deck with machined titanium overhang & recessed keybed shadow, 3D protruding titanium knobs, bold typography, and unified ChromaCorePro into ChromaCoreVST.

ChromaCorePro.notes: Unified into ChromaCoreVST v2.9.0: Updating automatically merges legacy ChromaCorePro into ChromaCoreVST.dll with Osc 4 Internal Synth Resampler, 14-source Right-Click Modulation Matrix, Organic Wavetable Interference Visualizer, and 3D Titanium Hardware UI.

ChromaPulse.notes: ChromaPulse v3.0.0: Nerve-style Step Sequencer Hotkeys (Ctrl+Click sub-divisions 1-8x, Alt+Click reverse with arrow badge, Shift+Click mute, [, ] pattern shifts, Ctrl+C/V bar clipboard, D bar duplicate), Interactive AHDSR Multi-Segment Envelope Canvas on waveform deck, and Master Bus Spectral-Adaptive Magic Drive.

ChromaDeep.notes: ChromaDeep v2.9.0: Upgraded ZDF Moog Ladder filter with inter-stage zero-DC tube saturation and dynamic input-envelope resonance damping (eliminating high-resonance limit-cycle whistles), added Prophet-6/OB-6 per-voice stereo panning & VCO thermal drift, Class-A AnalogConsoleStage output stage, Jury-stabilized Delay EQ biquads, and Clipboard [FEEDBACK] reporting.

ChromaX.notes: ChromaX v2.9.0: Added Prophet-6/OB-6 polyphonic stereo voice panning & per-voice VCO thermal drift, upgraded Asimov/BlueMonark 4-Pole Ladder filters with inter-stage zero-DC tube saturation and input-envelope resonance damping, and added Class-A AnalogConsoleStage master output transformer saturation with NaN self-healing.

ChromaComp.notes: ChromaComp v2.9.0: Fixed High-Shelf (H-SH) biquad b2 coefficient sign bug, added Jury stability triangle pole clamping (SanitizeBiquadCoefficients) and NaN/Inf self-healing across all 20 dynamic EQ & detector biquads, and upgraded [FEEDBACK] Clipboard diagnostic reporting.

ChromaVerb.notes: ChromaVerb v2.9.1: Added Jury stability triangle pole clamping (SanitizeBiquadCoefficients) and NaN/Inf self-healing across all Decay Rate & Post-EQ biquad filters, plus upgraded 1-click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostic reporting.

ChromaDelay.notes: ChromaDelay v2.9.0: Added NaN/Inf self-healing circuit breaker and Jury pole stability across all feedback loop EQ biquads in BBD MN3005, 15 IPS Tape, Oil-Can, Digital, and Shimmer delay engines, plus upgraded Clipboard [FEEDBACK] reporting.

ChromaFhaser.notes: ChromaFhaser v2.9.0: Fixed High-Shelf (H-SH) biquad b2 coefficient sign bug, added Jury stability triangle pole clamping across all 24 parametric EQ bands, and upgraded 1-click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostic reporting.

ChromaSlice.notes: ChromaSlice v2.9.0: Integrated ChromaAnalogSuite stability protection and upgraded 1-click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostic reporting.

ChromaTransientShaper.notes: ChromaTransientShaper v2.9.0: Integrated ChromaAnalogSuite stability protection and upgraded 1-click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostic reporting.

ChromaVoice.notes: ChromaVoice v3.2.1: Integrated ChromaAnalogSuite stability protection and upgraded 1-click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostic reporting.

ChromaWidener.notes: ChromaWidener v2.9.0: Integrated ChromaAnalogSuite stability protection and upgraded 1-click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostic reporting.

ChromaDesigner.notes: ChromaDesigner v2.9.0: Integrated ChromaAnalogSuite stability protection and upgraded 1-click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostic reporting.

ChromaScramble.notes: ChromaScramble v2.9.0: Upgraded to Low-Color Slate/Ice-Blue/Amber Hardware Theme, 3D Protruding Titanium Rotary Knobs in a clean single-row layout, High-Contrast Segoe UI Bold Typography across all 10 lanes and tabs, 2x Oversampled ADAA Analog Console Output Stage, and 1-Click Clipboard [FEEDBACK] telemetry.
